data_rules: World of Warcraft: Forever itemization is distinct from existing Classic data and must be researched as Forever data.

Blizzard confirms every dungeon drop has been re-examined, hundreds of new drops have been added, unique dungeon boss items are blue quality, world-drop epics have been improved, and hundreds of new rare-creature drops have been added.
Do not copy Classic item stats, item levels, drop rates, or bind types unless Forever explicitly confirms them.
Every populated item should carry source_ids and a clear status.
